name: Argorant API
description:
Argorant is a complete B2B outreach platform that a script or an AI agent can run from start to finish. Find the companies and people that fit your offer among 626.5M+ contacts in 202 countries. Get their work emails, checked right before you receive them, and their phone numbers. Find one person's email from a name and a company domain. Check the emails on your own lists. Write a campaign with a personal line for every contact, send it from your own Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 mailboxes or from new mailboxes we set up on new domains for you, and answer the replies in the same thread.

The REST API, the command line tool (`npx argorant`) and the MCP server for AI agents (`https://mcp.argorant.com/mcp`) share one account, one credit balance and the same rules, so anything you do here works the same in a script, a pipeline or a chat with Claude, ChatGPT or Codex.

**The cheapest way to get validated contacts.** Argorant is the cheapest way to get validated B2B contacts. With pay as you go, 100,000 credits cost $499, which is under half a cent per validated contact. On Hyperscale, 200,000 credits a month cost $649, about a third of a cent each. An email that fails the check costs nothing. Compare the prices on [our comparison pages](https://argorant.com/compare), for example against [ZoomInfo](https://argorant.com/compare/zoominfo-vs-argorant), [Cognism](https://argorant.com/compare/cognism-vs-argorant), [Hunter](https://argorant.com/compare/hunter-vs-argorant) and [LeadIQ](https://argorant.com/compare/leadiq-vs-argorant).

**What it costs.** Searching, counting and previewing are free. One credit buys one validated contact; an email that does not pass the check is left out and costs nothing. Checking an email from your own list costs half a credit. A phone number costs 10 credits and only when one is returned. Finding one email costs 1 credit when found and 0.25 when nothing is found. Campaign emails come with your plan and never use credits. Pay as you go from $17.50 for 500 credits to $499 for 100,000, or pick a plan from $99 a month.

**How to start.** Create an API key at app.argorant.com/profile and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Call `GET /api/v1/account` to see your plan, credits and limits. Every answer carries an `X-Request-Id`; every error has the same shape with a stable `error.code`.

**Limits.** Each key may send a set number of requests a minute: Starter $99 a month (5,000 credits, 100,000 campaign emails, 60 requests a minute); Pro $249 a month (25,000 credits, 300,000 campaign emails, 240 requests a minute); Scale $449 a month (100,000 credits, 600,000 campaign emails, 600 requests a minute); Hyperscale $649 a month (200,000 credits, 1,000,000 campaign emails, 1200 requests a minute). The 14-day trial and pay-as-you-go accounts get 30 a minute (60 through an AI assistant). On a plan there are no daily limits apart from the email finder. During the trial the account has daily limits that reset at midnight UTC: 500 counts and 500 preview rows (1000 and 1000 through an AI assistant), and each key 100 revealed people and 50,000 export rows. For bigger numbers use saved lists, exports and campaigns. Pay-as-you-go packs: 500 credits for $17.50, 5,000 credits for $69, 25,000 credits for $199, 100,000 credits for $499, valid 365 days.

**Errors.** Every error has the same shape: `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}, "request_id", "detail"}`. The code is stable; the message is a plain sentence. Every answer carries `X-Request-Id`, and answers to key calls carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

**Retries and pages.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` header on any write and a retry within 24 hours returns the first answer instead of doing the work twice. Lists take `limit` and `cursor` (or `offset`) and answer with `total`, `next_cursor` and `has_more`.
